records.title: DEMAND FOR FILLING VACANCY OF CHAIRMAN OF PRESS COUNCIL OF INDIA
details:
SHRI VIVEK K. TANKHA (MADHYA PRADESH): Sir, the Press
Council of India is an independent body under the Information and Broadcasting
Ministry which is formed with the sole purpose to put a check on the abuse of
power by media houses and to make sure that they operate in a judicious and
fair manner. Chandramauli Kumar Prasad. J (Retd.) was appointed as the Chairman of the Press Council
of India in November, 2014. He was re-appointed as the Chairman in May, 2018. November,
2021 marked the end of his tenure as the PCI Chairman and according to Section
6 (7) of the PCI Act, he cannot be further appointed as the Chairman. 
With no new appointment, this has
created a vacuum in the self-regulatory body of the PCI, leaving the management
and scrutiny of the press houses in disarray. As Sections 13 and 14 of the PCI
Act enumerates powers that are conferred upon the PCI for maintaining the
standard code of conduct for the Press and ruling out the anomalies in their
functioning. In the absence of a Chairman and the scrutiny committee, it is
most likely to happen that journalism houses would
obliterate professional standards for malefic gains and can even compromise
with the idea of fair and independent journalism. Whether the Government has
started the process of selection of the next Chairman of the Press Council of
India? 
(Ends)
